help.title: Help & Support
help.kisanDesc: Farming questions, 6 AM–10 PM, in your language
help.aiText: AI answers and photo checks are preliminary guidance, not a lab test or doctor's diagnosis. Always confirm serious problems with an expert.
help.q1: How do I check my crop for disease?
help.a1: Open Agri → Scan Crop, take clear daylight photos of the affected leaves, and tap Analyse with AI.
help.q2: How do I record pond water quality?
help.a2: Open Aqua → Record Water and type the values from your test kit or meter. The app shows if they are in the guide range.
help.a3: Add a vaccination with a due date on the animal's page. You get a phone reminder at 7 AM on that day.
help.q4: How do I change the language?
help.a4: Tap EN / తెలుగు / हिन्दी at the top of the home screen, or go to Profile → App language.
help.q5: Can I ask questions by voice?
help.a5: Yes. Open AI Advisor and tap the microphone. Speak in English, Telugu or Hindi.
help.a6: Only you. Your farms, ponds, animals and photos are private to your account.

monitor.title: Monitor
monitor.emptyText: Connect an ESP32 sensor to see live soil, pond or animal data — or try a simulated device first.
monitor.simulatedNote: Devices marked SIMULATED show demo data, not real measurements. They can never switch real equipment.

devices.simulatedHelp: Creates a demo device with 24 hours of sample data so you can try the app. All its data is labelled SIMULATED.
devices.name: Device name

noLink.pond: Add a pond first to link this sensor.
noLink.farm: Add a farm first to link this device.
noLink.animal: Add an animal first to link this collar.

devices.sensorsHelp: Tick only the sensors physically wired to this board. Readings from other sensors will be rejected.
devices.maxRunHint: The board switches it off after this, even if the network drops.
devices.maxRunInvalid: Maximum run time must be 1–240 minutes.
devices.safety: Have a licensed electrician fit a contactor and motor protection. Never switch a motor directly with a small relay.
devices.keyOnceText: It is shown only once. Put it in the device's secrets.h. If you lose it, rotate the key.
devices.firmwareHint: Flash the AgriAqua firmware (firmware/esp32 in the project) with these values. The device appears online after its first upload.
devices.rotateText: The old key stops working immediately. Update the device with the new key.
devices.deleteText: Its readings, alerts and rules are deleted too.

equipment.manualText: The local manual switch is in use, so the app cannot control this equipment.
equipment.confirmText: Make sure nobody is working near the equipment.

simulator.title: Simulator
simulator.help: Send a simulated reading. Pick a scenario to test alerts.

thresholds.title: Alert limits · {{param}}
thresholds.help: You get an alert when a reading goes below the minimum or above the maximum. Leave both empty to switch off.
thresholds.invalid: Enter numbers; minimum must be below maximum.

calibration.title: Calibrate
calibration.help: Compare with a trusted meter. Value shown = raw × scale + offset.
calibration.invalid: Scale must be a positive number.

rules.title: Automation
rules.safety: Rules only react to real sensor readings (never simulated ones). The device's maximum run time and manual switch always win.
rules.needRealSensor: Rules need a real (not simulated) sensor.
rules.noneText: Example: when dissolved oxygen drops below 4 mg/L, run the aerator for 30 minutes.
rules.enableText: The app will switch the equipment automatically when the condition is met.
rules.name: Rule name
rules.namePlaceholder: e.g. Aerate when oxygen is low
rules.startsOff: New rules start switched off. Turn them on after checking.
rules.incomplete: Fill in every part of the rule.
rules.tooLong: Run time must be within the equipment's maximum.
